description: Source code for a SwiftUI view and associated model handling system run settings, including agent selection, security policies, allowlist management, and UI components.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: Observable class managing the state and logic for system run approval settings, including agent management, security policies, allowlist entries, and interaction with external stores.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes agent list and loads current settings for the selected agent.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of available agents from configuration store.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Selects an agent by ID and refreshes corresponding settings.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads approval settings for a specified agent ID.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates the security policy for the current context.

methods.name: setAsk
methods.description: Updates the ask policy for the current context.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic skill CLI allowlisting and refreshes skill bins accordingly.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist entry after validation, returning validation reason if invalid.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry after validation, returning validation reason if invalid.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an allowlist entry by ID and updates the store.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by UUID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Validates if a pattern string is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the list of skill bins if auto-allow is enabled.
